statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Diagnosis code I47.1 applies to this patient
Diagnosis code I25.10 applies to this patient
CPT code 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The denial was based on failure to obtain required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
